data_license: public domain per statsmodels dataset documentation
selection_policy: A model is eligible only if it completes every validation origin and horizon without a fit failure
test_policy: Selection is frozen before the 2001 test run; test evaluates only naive baselines and the selected model
interval_policy: ETS/naive/ML intervals use training residual scale; ARIMA intervals use model forecast distribution
diagnostic_policy: Ljung-Box is descriptive on selected test errors; it does not retroactively tune the model
